map.多半是设备上没有配置邮件客户端，或扫码工具把 mailto: 当成普通文本打开。: Usually the device has no mail client configured, or the scanner app treats mailto: as plain text. Whether mailto works depends heavily on system settings: on phones it is normally bound already, while desktops need a client installed and set as the default mail app. For printed materials, also print the address itself as a fallback.
